name: sauda
description: Sauda: Android-first agentic shop manager for Indian kirana and wholesale owners

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sauda/shared && npm run dev -w @sauda/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sauda/shared && npm run build -w @sauda/api && npm run build -w @sauda/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sauda/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.boundaries: npm run boundaries:code && npm run boundaries:deps
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run boundaries && npm run test && npm run build
